extracted.name: How to cook asparagus
extracted.description: Learn how to prepare and cook asparagus with this simple recipe – we've focused on cooking asparagus in the oven but also included other methods below.
instruction_lines: Snap any woody tips off the asparagus where they naturally break apart. Put on a roasting tray, drizzle with oil and season with salt and pepper.
